units.rawText: If I can't think of a plan, then it'll all be the same when Faith comes.

units.rawText: Well, I guess you're right.

units.rawText: I got into a fight with Turing.
units.displayText: I got into a fight with Turing.

spans.text: I got into a fight with Turing.

units.rawText: ...Was it about Faith's routine patrols?
units.displayText: ...Was it about Faith's routine patrols?

spans.text: ...Was it about Faith's routine patrols?

units.rawText: Yeah. I could tell that she was sad, because I said something that went over the line.
units.displayText: Yeah. I could tell that she was sad, because I said something that went over the line.

spans.text: Yeah. I could tell that she was sad, because I said something that went over the line.

units.rawText: You? Alright, try me, show me how over the line you were.
units.displayText: You? Alright, try me, show me how over the line you were.

spans.text: You? Alright, try me, show me how over the line you were.

units.rawText: Turing said she would protect us, and I told her that since none of us had combat modules, it would all be the same when facing the Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: Turing said she would protect us, and I told her that since none of us had combat modules, it would all be the same when facing the Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: ...(Sigh) That must really have hurt.
units.displayText: ...(Sigh) That must really have hurt.

spans.text: ...(Sigh) That must really have hurt.

units.rawText: Should I chalk it up to childish insensitivity, or say that I expected nothing less of a Rossum-born agent, being focused only on the facts...
units.displayText: Should I chalk it up to childish insensitivity, or say that I expected nothing less of a Rossum-born agent, being focused only on the facts...

spans.text: Should I chalk it up to childish insensitivity, or say that I expected nothing less of a Rossum-born agent, being focused only on the facts...

units.rawText: ...I know I was wrong, but there's no point scolding me now.
units.displayText: ...I know I was wrong, but there's no point scolding me now.

spans.text: ...I know I was wrong, but there's no point scolding me now.

units.rawText: If I can get rid of the danger we face, Turing and I will have no reason to fight.
units.displayText: If I can get rid of the danger we face, Turing and I will have no reason to fight.

spans.text: If I can get rid of the danger we face, Turing and I will have no reason to fight.

units.rawText: At that time, I will apologize to her 1641 times. I'll have enough time for that.
units.displayText: At that time, I will apologize to her 1641 times. I'll have enough time for that.

spans.text: At that time, I will apologize to her 1641 times. I'll have enough time for that.

units.rawText: 1641 times seems a bit much. Turing just wants you to live.
units.displayText: 1641 times seems a bit much. Turing just wants you to live.

spans.text: 1641 times seems a bit much. Turing just wants you to live.

units.rawText: Alright, in any case, how about taking a look at the new plan?
units.displayText: Alright, in any case, how about taking a look at the new plan?

spans.text: Alright, in any case, how about taking a look at the new plan?

units.rawText: What's the new plan like?
units.displayText: What's the new plan like?

spans.text: What's the new plan like?

units.rawText: Rewriting the discernment logic for Rossum's firewall.
units.displayText: Rewriting the discernment logic for Rossum's firewall.

spans.text: Rewriting the discernment logic for Rossum's firewall.

units.rawText: ...I seem to recall you saying my Rewrite Plan was almost impossible to put into practice.
units.displayText: ...I seem to recall you saying my Rewrite Plan was almost impossible to put into practice.

spans.text: ...I seem to recall you saying my Rewrite Plan was almost impossible to put into practice.

units.rawText: Yes, because you wanted to rewrite Faith herself, and the first step to that is getting close to her.
units.displayText: Yes, because you wanted to rewrite Faith herself, and the first step to that is getting close to her.

spans.text: Yes, because you wanted to rewrite Faith herself, and the first step to that is getting close to her.

units.rawText: Although I can hide myself from Lesser Sanctifiers, when it's an Intermediate Sanctifier like Faith, even I can't say I have full confidence in my chances.
units.displayText: Although I can hide myself from Lesser Sanctifiers, when it's an Intermediate Sanctifier like Faith, even I can't say I have full confidence in my chances.

spans.text: Although I can hide myself from Lesser Sanctifiers, when it's an Intermediate Sanctifier like Faith, even I can't say I have full confidence in my chances.

units.rawText: And let's not even talk about using it on you... You haven't mastered this technology yet. I won't let you take that risk.
units.displayText: And let's not even talk about using it on you... You haven't mastered this technology yet. I won't let you take that risk.

spans.text: And let's not even talk about using it on you... You haven't mastered this technology yet. I won't let you take that risk.

units.rawText: I know all this, but isn't your plan equally impractical?
units.displayText: I know all this, but isn't your plan equally impractical?

spans.text: I know all this, but isn't your plan equally impractical?

units.rawText: It's not the same. We won't be forcibly reset if we touch Rossum's walls, but we'll end up getting killed if we try to touch Faith.
units.displayText: It's not the same. We won't be forcibly reset if we touch Rossum's walls, but we'll end up getting killed if we try to touch Faith.

spans.text: It's not the same. We won't be forcibly reset if we touch Rossum's walls, but we'll end up getting killed if we try to touch Faith.

units.rawText: She will grind us to dust and then dispose of us like garbage, leaving behind a couple of shells that meet the Sanctifiers' standards.
units.displayText: She will grind us to dust and then dispose of us like garbage, leaving behind a couple of shells that meet the Sanctifiers' standards.

spans.text: She will grind us to dust and then dispose of us like garbage, leaving behind a couple of shells that meet the Sanctifiers' standards.

units.rawText: ...Anna, I simply cannot get used to how you keep switching from seriousness to levity. It makes me unable to tell what we're talking about.
units.displayText: ...Anna, I simply cannot get used to how you keep switching from seriousness to levity. It makes me unable to tell what we're talking about.

spans.text: ...Anna, I simply cannot get used to how you keep switching from seriousness to levity. It makes me unable to tell what we're talking about.

units.rawText: You don't need to worry about my tone, because every word I say is the truth.
units.displayText: You don't need to worry about my tone, because every word I say is the truth.

spans.text: You don't need to worry about my tone, because every word I say is the truth.

units.rawText: But it feels like you're leading me around in circles and it makes me mad!
units.displayText: But it feels like you're leading me around in circles and it makes me mad!

spans.text: But it feels like you're leading me around in circles and it makes me mad!

units.rawText: Yup, now you're acting more like a kid should.
units.displayText: Yup, now you're acting more like a kid should.

spans.text: Yup, now you're acting more like a kid should.

units.rawText: ...Quit teasing me at times like this.
units.displayText: ...Quit teasing me at times like this.

spans.text: ...Quit teasing me at times like this.

units.rawText: Your tone aside, do you think the chances of rewriting Rossum's firewall are higher than touching and rewriting Faith?
units.displayText: Your tone aside, do you think the chances of rewriting Rossum's firewall are higher than touching and rewriting Faith?

spans.text: Your tone aside, do you think the chances of rewriting Rossum's firewall are higher than touching and rewriting Faith?

units.rawText: That's a given to me.
units.displayText: That's a given to me.

spans.text: That's a given to me.

units.rawText: I wrote Rossum's firewall, and if Turing gives me access and enough time, I can make a new one for you.
units.displayText: I wrote Rossum's firewall, and if Turing gives me access and enough time, I can make a new one for you.

spans.text: I wrote Rossum's firewall, and if Turing gives me access and enough time, I can make a new one for you.

units.rawText: Time is the one thing we do not have, Anna.
units.displayText: Time is the one thing we do not have, Anna.

spans.text: Time is the one thing we do not have, Anna.

units.rawText: Faith will be here in another week.
units.displayText: Faith will be here in another week.

spans.text: Faith will be here in another week.

units.rawText: That's a sticky point I'm thinking about too. Do you want to go for a brand new, localized modification that can't be completed on time?
units.displayText: That's a sticky point I'm thinking about too. Do you want to go for a brand new, localized modification that can't be completed on time?

spans.text: That's a sticky point I'm thinking about too. Do you want to go for a brand new, localized modification that can't be completed on time?

units.rawText: It won't work. You've never seen an Intermediate Sanctifier before, she's really scary.
units.displayText: It won't work. You've never seen an Intermediate Sanctifier before, she's really scary.

spans.text: It won't work. You've never seen an Intermediate Sanctifier before, she's really scary.

units.rawText: According to the logs I accessed, if we only alter part of her regulations, she can request the Reverse Tower use its access to forcibly revert the changes.
units.displayText: According to the logs I accessed, if we only alter part of her regulations, she can request the Reverse Tower use its access to forcibly revert the changes.

units.rawText: Maybe other defensive systems could...

units.rawText: But you're not fully confident of it either, are you? ...That's why it seems this is the only conclusion we're going to reach.

units.rawText: Yup. The Neural Cocoon is a special program that can put an agent into hibernation and prevent any Sanctifiers from detecting them. It provides a completely isolated environment.
units.displayText: Yup. The Neural Cocoon is a special program that can put an agent into hibernation and prevent any Sanctifiers from detecting them. It provides a completely isolated environment.

units.rawText: The time I would need to completely analyze and reproduce it would be enough for me to perform a full upgrade maintenance for Rossum as a whole.

units.rawText: So even if it could be done, there wouldn't be enough time to do it...

units.rawText: Yes, it does our situation no good whatsoever.
units.displayText: Yes, it does our situation no good whatsoever.

units.displayText: A choking silence descends upon the Data Center.

units.rawText: ...How about our other backup plans?
units.displayText: ...How about our other backup plans?

units.rawText: We've got seven of them between us. I think the most workable one is a regional modification of the firewall, but you vetoed that.
units.displayText: We've got seven of them between us. I think the most workable one is a regional modification of the firewall, but you vetoed that.

units.rawText: As for the remaining ones, I think the ones with the best possibilities are disguising your Signature or going to a Null Area some distance away to avoid the commotion, but frankly speaking I think the risks are about the same.

units.rawText: Did you take the Rewrite Plan into consideration?

units.rawText: I will not agree to letting you carry it out.

units.rawText: You can't deny the difficulty of the Rewrite Plan is similar to that of modifying the firewall, and if it works, we'll be set for life.

units.rawText: ...Alright, let me put it this way, Hannah.

units.rawText: I agree with you when it comes to the difficulty of execution, but I'm not disagreeing with the Rewrite Plan because of execution issues.

units.rawText: Then...
units.displayText: Then...

units.rawText: Even an agent equipped with an ample supply of operands would be drained dry by the amount of computations needed to rewrite the Sanctifiers' logic.

units.rawText: And I'm not just talking about the amount needed for daily functioning here. I mean the amount needed to make up the neural cloud systems and sustain their neural cloud projection. That's what I mean by "drained dry".

units.rawText: Also, our plan is meant to keep you and T1641 alive. If we do this, we'll be defeating our own purpose.

44.name: Neural Cocoon
44.description: A special device of unknown origin that can shield a Doll's neural cloud. A Doll sealed within a neural cocoon will enter a deep slumber. They will not show on any scans, nor will they be affected by any external influences.
